tijori.business_description: SteamHouse India, incorporated in 2015, is an industrial gas company engaged in the generation and distribution of steam and nitrogen through its pipeline network. Its business segments include steam generation and distribution, steam purchase and distribution, nitrogen separation and supply, and coal trading.
